translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

book.name: 1 Corintios
book.title: Pablo Kepegin Jesúsgin-kwenamalad-Corintogin-pukmaladga Karta Palmijad 1 Corintios

content: Kwenadgan, imi pe takto, Israel-tulemalgin igi kus. Imi anmal-tadgan-pel-kwapa mogil-ulpal kudigusmal, tegin Termal-Kinnid-abalgin opasmalbal.
Tenal anmal-tadgan-pel-kwapa mogil-abalgin-nadedbal, tegin termalgin-opajadbal, tule-tigin-oglejadyob Moisés-igalgin togzhamal.
Tegin anmal-tadgan-pel-kwapa Pab-mas-kunned-palmialid kuchamal,
tegin Pab-kobed-palmialid kobzhamalbal. Tenal anmal-tadgan ti-kobzhamalad, akwa-tummad-purpaled-akar noni. Tenal we akwa-purpaleddin anmal-tadganbak natap-kus. Tenal we akwadin, Cristo.

Tenal anmal-tadgan-pel-kwapa termal opasmal, tegin Pab-mas-palmialid kuchamal, tegin Pab-ti-palmialid kobzhamalbal. Tenal Pab Tummad anmal-tadganbak yer itoged-wiluban. Tenal anmal-tadgan-Pabbak-iskujadbal, Pab Tummad anmal-tadgan-mechamal. Al anmal-tadgan-e-muimal neg-nikchulidbal akne-akne miled-pesmal.
Imi akpene immalmal-pel-kwapa kujad anmalga iktualeba oyonai, anmal melle istar-naneedgin pinzhemalgal, anmal-tadgan nanedi-kusmaladyob.
Tenal anmal-tadgan-wal-walgwen kujadyob, pe melle chowal-mimmiganzhe kolmalo. Tenal Pab-kartagin chogdo:
Tenal anmal-tadgan-wal-walgwen ome-pidgin-yolesmaladyob pe melle yolemalmogo. Imi teun Pab Tummad iba-kwénnagin mili-tulagwen-kakapá tulemal-mecha.
Tenal anmal-tadgan-wal-walgwen Pab-Tummad-wilub-takchamaladyob, anmal melle Pab-wilub-takmalmogo. Imi teun anmal-tadgan nakpegin-naklikujadbal purkwismal.
Tenal anmal-tadgan-wal-walgwen Pab Tummadbak istar kudigusmaladyob, pe melle istar-itogedbal Pabzhe urwemalo. Imi teun Pab-angel-tule-mejed anmal-tadgan-mechamal.

Imi anmal-tadgan-weob-kusmalad, tadgan-pesmaladga iktualeba chagla-chis tadgan-purkwismalad-kujadyob melle kumalmogo. Tenal akpene anmal-tadgan-purkwismaladgin-kusmalad Pab-kartagin nermakal-pesbal, anmalga wilub oyonai, imis-anmal-pukwamalad melle tadgan-purkwismaladyob nanemalgalmo.
Imi pemal chogmalal: “Antin Pabbak nued kudii,” tenal pe nue aga takermal, melle iskuedgin arkwanmalo, anmal-tadgan kujadyobmo.

Tenal pemalga wilub-taklenonikil, tulemalga pel-kwapa ampa weob wilub-taklenonidamo. Tenal Pabdin tule-innikigwad-choggu, al Pab igal-kwen-ukojul-kuo, pe unnijulidzhe pe wilub-taklenonigal. Tenal pemalzhe wilub-takleged nonikil, Pabdin keg-chulgu pega igal-nooed uko, pe wilub-takleged abin-purtigal.
Kwenamalad-an-pemal-pilalmalad, an pemalga chogzhundo: “Imi pemal melle chowal-mimmigan-waglik kwisgumalo, pe ilgwen nemalo.”
Tenal pemal-pinzheed-nikmalad, pemal wismal, an-pemalga-chogzhiid ib-nued o ib-istar.

Imi anmal Pab-kobedga tog-nuedi-chogdael, wedin pato oyonai, Pab nugu anmalgin pinzhe. Tenal anmal we kobed kobzhal, ¿wedin pato choglenaibalzhulzhí, Cristo-abe-milejadbal anmal pato Cristogadmo? Teobdo. Teginbal, ¿anmal purwi-purwi-madu-mimileged kuchal, wedin pato choglenaibalzhulzhí, anmal pato Cristogadmo? Teobdo.
Tenal madu-walkwénnagwando, tenal anmal-pel-kwapa madu-walkwénnagwad-kuchamaladbal, chan-walkwénna kunonibal.
Imi pe takto, Israel-tulemal igi kusmal. Imi Israel-tulemal Pabga-immalmal-ukchamalad kuchamalgu, ¿we tulemal oyonaichulzhí, emalde Pab Tummadbak-mecha-kudimalad? Teobdo.
Tenal an pemalga chogzhadbal, ¿pemal ebinzhemal, an pemalga chogdabalo, we immalmal chowal-mimmiganga ukchaddin, ib-nued? ¿Imi chowal-mimmigande, ib-chunchunnad? Chulá.
Tenal tulemal-Pab-wichulmalad chowal-mimmiganga-immal-ukchamalad niamalga ukchamal, Pab-Tummad-Chunnadga kwen ukchajulmal. Al antin, an peichul, pemal niamalbak mes akemal.

Tenal pe Pab-Jesúsbal nail, keg pe pog-pel kobed kobel. Pedin Pab-Jesús-kobedbi pe kobenab, tenal nia-kobed keg pe kobel. Teginbal, pe Pab-Jesúsbal nail, keg pe pog-pel mas-kunned kunpalil, pe Pab-Jesús-mas-kunnedbi kunnenab, tenal nia-mas-kunned keg pe kunpalil.

Tenal an-chogzhadyob pe imajulmalal, ¿pe igi peimalzhun? ¿Pab pegin nobgu? Antin chog chul. Tenal pemal nia-mas kunnel, pe wijirmal, Pab pe nobedbal sapejul pe-oturdako. Imi pemal peimalal, Pab pegin nobgu ¿pemal Pab Tummadga pul kannaleged nikají, chogbo-igalgin nanegal? Chulá.
Tule-Pab-Jesúsbal-nued-nanimalad melle iskuedgin tule-pid-egwano
Imi anmal igal-nika pél immal imagal, tenal immalmal-pel-kwapa nueganbijul. Tenal anmal igal-nikado pél immal imagal, tenal we immalmal-pel-kwapa tule-kwen-pentajul Pab-Jesúsgin tunkugal.
Imi tulega igal-kwen-maichuldo, aga tukingabi immal imagal ega ib-nuedga kugal. Tenal pemal immal imakenabmal tulemalga ib-nuedga kugal.
Imisgin an pega chogzhundo, imi tule-chan-ukmalad-neggin pe chan pakel, meke-ibi-chan pe akalzhul kunmalo, pe melle pinzhedamalo: “¿We chan chowal-mimmiganga ukchadilyé?”
¿Ibiga an teob chog? Imi Pab-kartagin chogdo:
Sal. 24:1 Al pe akalzhul we chan kunmalo.

Imi tule-walgwen-Pab-wichulid peje kolnonikil, mas wis kunnegal, pe we tulebak nebiel, pe akalzhul naodo. Tegin pe mas-kunned-neg omojal, pe yogasal mas-kunpied pe kunno. Tenal pe melle ekiso, we chande chowal-mimmiganga ukchad o chul.
Tenal meke-ibi-tule pega chogalil: “We chan chowal-mimmiganga uklejad,” pe melle kunno, tule-pega-chogzhad melle akal pe-takegal, tegin pe melle aga ulubgin akal-itogalbal.

Tenal an pega chogzhul: “Pe melle ulubgin akal-itogal,” tenal an chog: “Tule-pega-chogzhad melle ulubgin akal-itogal.” Tenal an wisdo, pemal-wal-walgwen chogdamalo: “¿Tede tule-pid-akal-itogedbal ankin igal-kao, an melle chan kunkal? Chulá. Keg kue.
Tenal an Pab-Tummad-Tuladga changa tog-nuedi chogzhal, ¿ibiga an chan kunnojul-kuo? Antin igal-nikado chan kunkal.” Tenal pemal keg chogmalal, antin keg chan kunnel.
Al meke-ibi pe kobel, meke-ibi-mas pe kunnel, meke-ibi pe imakel, pél pe imakenab, Pab-Tummad-nug-okannogal.
Tenal pemal melle iskuedgin tule-egwano, meke Judiomal, meke Griegomal, meke Jesúsgin-kwenadgan.
Imi antin an nanemodo, tule-pimalad yer-itogal. Tenal antin naga tukingabi nanejul, tenal tule-pimaladga ib-nuedga kugal, we tulemal Jesúsbal abonolego-dewa o chul-dewa.
